name: nobitex-scanner-android
description: Capacitor Android wrapper for Nobitex multi-strategy scanner v7.7.1

scripts.android:build: npm run android:prepare && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleDebug
scripts.validate: node scripts/validate-release.mjs && node scripts/test-indicators.mjs && node scripts/test-indicator-reference-vectors.mjs && node scripts/test-opportunity-engine.mjs && node scripts/test-opportunity-history.mjs && node scripts/test-surveillance-engine.mjs
scripts.android:release: npm run android:prepare && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon --stacktrace assembleRelease
